comment: slots x/y: visual center pixel coords in the 1080-wide reference space. optional slot_x/slot_y: offset from x/y to the center of the slot control/click area; defaults to 0/0. For scrollable biomes the y axis extends beyond 1920 to cover the full long background. workers_button: x_from_right/y_from_bottom = center distance from the screen bottom-right corner (always a static screen-space position, same for scrollable and non-scrollable biomes). All sizes/positions are 1080-wide reference pixels scaled at runtime. availability: 'free' = included in base game, 'paid' = requires purchase/unlock.
